I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is PD-4821.

He posted it himself in #central-team on Jun 9 at 10:46 AM. He wrote that PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply. He's a member of #central-team, which I confirmed from the channel list earlier, so this is something he could see on his own.

I also reminded him of the open issue from that same message: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02. I couldn't find any later message saying that was fixed.
